rate_mmr_exempt.long_name: Proportion of students exempt from MMR vaccination
rate_mmr_exempt.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with any exemption from the MMR vaccination requirement.
rate_mmr_exempt.long_description: Share of assessed school students holding an exemption of any kind from the MMR series. This is an exemption rate, not a coverage rate: a student without an exemption is not necessarily vaccinated, and an exempt student may still have received the vaccine, so it cannot be subtracted from one to obtain coverage.
rate_mmr_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students were exempt from MMR vaccination.

suppressed_flag.long_name: Indicator that at least one rate on this row was censored at source
suppressed_flag.short_description: 1 if at least one rate on this row was suppressed or top-coded by the source.
suppressed_flag.long_description: Set to 1 where the source published a censoring marker instead of a number for at least one measure on the row. Undirected markers leave the value missing. Where a bound is given, see censor_direction for which way it runs.
suppressed_flag.statement: In {location}, at least one reported rate was censored at source.

censor_direction.long_name: Direction in which a censored value on this row is bounded
censor_direction.short_description: Which way a censored value is bounded: left, right, undirected, or a combination.
censor_direction.long_description: "left" means the source printed a less-than marker, so the true value lies BELOW the stated threshold (a suppressed small cell such as "<5"). "right" means a greater-than marker, so the true value lies ABOVE it (a top code such as ">95%"). "undirected" means the value was withheld with no bound stated. Combinations are joined with "+" where a row carries more than one kind. Empty where nothing was censored. Left- and right-censoring pull an estimate in opposite directions, so they are recorded separately rather than under a single suppression flag.
censor_direction.statement: In {location}, censored values on this row were bounded {value}.

oh_school_immunization.name: Ohio Kindergarten Immunization Assessment
oh_school_immunization.description: County-level kindergarten MMR exemption rates from the annual Ohio Kindergarten Immunization Level Assessment.
oh_school_immunization.restrictions: Public data published by the source agency; no access restrictions.
